questions: Did your difficulty walking begin suddenly?
Has it been getting worse over time?
Have you had any recent fall or injury?
Do you feel dizzy or as if the room is spinning when you walk?
Do you feel faint or lightheaded when standing or walking?
Do you have weakness in either leg?
Do you have numbness or tingling in either leg or foot?
Do you have pain in your back, hips, knees, or feet that affects your walking?
Does one foot drag or slap the floor when you walk?
Do you have trouble coordinating your legs or keeping your balance?
Have you noticed tremor, stiffness, or involuntary movements?
Do you have double vision, blurred vision, trouble speaking, facial weakness, or difficulty swallowing?
Have you had a severe or unusual headache?
Have you lost consciousness or had a seizure?
Do you have new problems controlling your bladder or bowels?
Have you recently started or changed any medications, alcohol use, or recreational drug use?
Have you had a stroke, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson’s disease, neuropathy, or another neurologic condition before?
Is your walking difficulty worse when you are being watched or when you feel anxious?
